description: Source code for quoting and unquoting strings, path quoting, and related utilities in C, used within a larger project (likely Git-related). Contains functions for shell-safe quoting, c-style quoting, and language-specific string literal quoting.

methods.name: need_bs_quote
methods.description: Checks if a character needs backslash quoting (single quote or exclamation mark).

methods.name: sq_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for shell safety, replacing quotes and exclamation marks, enclosing in single quotes.

methods.name: sq_quote_buf_pretty
methods.description: Quotes a string if necessary, otherwise copies it directly.

methods.name: sq_quotef
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-like formatting and quotes it.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments into a single string with proper shell quoting.

methods.name: sq_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Quotes an array of arguments with leading whitespace.

methods.name: sq_append_quote_argv_pretty
methods.description: Appends an array of arguments with proper quoting, separated by spaces.

methods.name: sq_dequote_step
methods.description: Dequotes a single-quoted string, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: sq_dequote
methods.description: Dequotes a string that was quoted with sq_quote_buf.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_argv
methods.description: Dequotes a string into an argument vector.

methods.name: sq_dequote_to_strvec
methods.description: Dequotes a string into a strvec.

methods.name: quote_c_style
methods.description: Quotes a string in C-style with double quotes, handling escapes.

methods.name: quote_two_c_style
methods.description: Quotes two strings in C-style, possibly enclosing in double quotes.

methods.name: write_name_quoted
methods.description: Writes a name quoted in C-style to a file, with optional terminator.

methods.name: write_name_quoted_relative
methods.description: Writes a relative path name quoted in C-style to a file.

methods.name: quote_path
methods.description: Quotes a path relative to a prefix, with optional quoting of spaces.

methods.name: unquote_c_style
methods.description: Unquotes a C-style quoted string, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Perl string literal.

methods.name: perl_quote_buf_with_len
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Perl string literal with specified length.

methods.name: python_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Python string literal.

methods.name: tcl_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string as a Tcl string literal.

methods.name: basic_regex_quote_buf
methods.description: Quotes a string for use in basic regular expressions.
